THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: B/E/3/MARGA SAN - 3/ACQ.

Land Mini No.: 4/3/7/2011/HW/149. I hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a Improvement of Peradeniya-Badulla-Chenkaladi Road.
Description of the land to be acquired:
